disposition_reason: A real ordered source endpoint exists: alpha pRF heldout prediction, including the reported43% median with baseline correction in Fig.7. The original electrode mask and metric implementation are not reconciled with the433-electrode local programme, its prospective equal-person mean, or the portable optimizer. Those local comparisons cannot certify surpassing the original source result.

source_paper.title: Precise spatial tuning of visually driven alpha oscillations in human visual cortex

evidence.locator: Results2.3 and2.6; Fig.7; Methods: electrode selection, spectral decomposition, pRF model fitting
evidence.supports: Original alpha/broadband pRF task, historical366-electrode selection and first/second-half cross-validation.

evidence.locator: Graphical and statistical support for primary claims, claim5; Fig.7 and Supplementary Fig.7-1
evidence.supports: Author claim summary reports median cross-validated variance explained43% with model-based correction versus10% without, with31 electrodes for the gain comparison.
Source linear Gaussian-surround route, zero-degree polynomial nuisance, full fit xvalmode0 and within-run cross-validation xvalmode2.
OpenNeuro ds004194 source archive and main/supplementary figure reproduction entrypoints.

evidence.locator: Operator method and resources; Protected grading API
evidence.supports: Local portable source-shaped comparator is not the historical optimizer;433 released electrodes, source-fold versus literal Eq6 distinction, and equal-person aggregation are explicitly disclosed.

target.description: Predict stimulus-location-dependent alpha and broadband amplitudes with population receptive-field models; the ordered comparison is original cross-validated prediction accuracy, including the source baseline-correction comparison. Larger alpha pRFs or stronger negative gain are descriptive checks, not win scores.

dataset.description: Author release identifies OpenNeuro ds004194; canonical task names version3.0.0. Bind the exact BIDS runs, aperture matrices and original derived timecourses to the paper experiment before comparing scores.

cohort.description: Paper selection yields366 electrodes from9 participants; the local released roster has433 electrodes. Recover the original QC/visual-selection and figure-specific31-electrode Fig.7 membership, without selecting electrodes by candidate performance.

split.description: Original two-fold within-run prediction: fit the first or second half of the75-sample timecourse, predict the opposite half, then concatenate predictions. The source wrapper uses xvalmode2. A new heldout-run split is an extension.

inputs.description: Original visual apertures and source ECoG responses with subject/electrode metadata; source spectral processing separates alpha suppression from broadband elevation before spatial fitting. Preserve alpha and broadband conditions.

preprocessing.description: Match original rereferencing, epoch rejection, evoked-response removal, spectral baseline model, beta nuisance terms and target-band selection. The local timecourse-only route does not establish full raw-to-paper parity.

metric.description: Higher cross-validated variance explained is ordered. Reconcile literal paper1−SSE/sum(response²) with the source routine’s foldwise DC projection and exact gain constraints; report percent units and preserve both formulas until equivalence is established.

aggregation.description: Fig.7 reports an electrode median; recover its exact original selection and aggregate. The local equal-person mean gain over433 released electrodes is a different estimand and cannot be compared numerically to43%.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Fig.7 median cross-validated alpha pRF variance explained (%)

published_baseline.description: Author claim summary for Fig.7 reports43% median with model-based baseline correction (10% without). This is a rounded published figure-level result; exact source values and selection remain necessary.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No original MATLAB author re-fit on the authenticated historical cohort. The local SciPy variable-projection/grid comparator is a separately authored method.

minimum_effect.rationale: Use a defensible change in out-of-sample alpha variance explained beyond source rounding and rerun variability; meaningful margin is not justified by the43-versus10 baseline contrast alone.

uncertainty.method: Specify a paired hierarchical uncertainty analysis for prediction improvement while retaining the original electrode median as point estimand; participant clustering and figure-specific sample size must be honored.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant; electrodes, folds and aperture samples are nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: The source explicitly examines participant nesting; source probabilistic atlas resampling is not new biological replication.

paper_win_requires: Bind the original366-electrode population and exact figure-specific selections; keep all required alpha/broadband and baseline contrasts.
Reproduce the source metric/gain branch and original median before claiming improvement over43% and the author rerun.
Do not count a corrected implementation, portable-optimizer advantage, equal-person433-electrode mean or a new split as an original-paper win.
Freeze the method, spectral preprocessing, aperture geometry, selection and uncertainty policy before final predictions.

current_sota.description: No separately source-verified current-SOTA comparison has been established.

episode.improvement_loop: Once the original endpoint is recovered, develop pRF/spectral models using only training halves and declared validation feedback; no final-half response may influence fitting seeds or model selection.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze all preprocessing, model families, gain bounds, original electrode mask, fold membership, numerical scoring and resource/access budgets.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate both methods on identical original held halves and report the source aggregate plus participant-aware uncertainty; retain descriptive spatial-scale and gain checks without turning them into success scores.
episode.baseline_policy: Published43% median, native author rerun and local portable comparator remain separate. Only an authenticated original-task comparison supports a paper win.

blocking_issues: Historical366-electrode mask and Fig.7 membership unresolved against433 released electrodes.
Original metric centering and gain branch not reconciled with current scorer.
No source-equivalent raw-to-fit preprocessing and competent native author rerun.
Effect margin, clustered decision rule and concrete episode budgets not fixed.

legacy.notes: Retain spectral/spatial reconstruction and all original grading materials as calibration. The local prospective equal-person corrected-alpha score and SciPy comparator are extensions until the historical source estimand is recovered.
